biotools.summary: INSaFLU-TELEVIR is a free, open-source bioinformatics suite for viral metagenomic detection and routine genomic surveillance, designed for both web-based and locally installable use. It supports various sequencing technologies (Illumina, Ion Torrent, Oxford Nanopore) and includes modules for genome assembly, variant calling, and phylogeographic analysis.
